title: Identify European Bank switch arrays
platforms: European ROM; Windows via Wine and static analysis
changes: Record three indexed switch-array source contracts covering the remaining Bank sample words; extraction and runtime ownership remain open.
validation: Wine disassembly 9uc90bfb and protected source plan in0jqgky authenticate original instructions, 269 destinations across 1076 source bytes, three existing roots, target shapes and the absence of current owner overlaps.
limitations: The retained capture can include nested read scopes and does not prove all callers or scenes. Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance comparison was performed.
